name: Tom Hardwick
role: Manager of the Rocky Mountain show

…a short time ago while they were exhibiting in Chicago. They were doing a big business, but the manager, Tom Hardwick, thought it would be more profitable to bust than to pay the employes their salaries. The Indians and their interpreter were left penniless, and had to sell their stock…
